title.en: Caring veterinarians beside strained reception service

text.en: Many clients express deep gratitude for compassionate veterinarians like Dr. David O'Keefe and Dr. Nataliia, noting their kind bedside manner with cats, dogs, and small pocket pets. In contrast, several reviewers report negative interactions at the front desk, citing unhelpful communication, rude phone demeanor, and abrupt dismissals during stressful visits.

title.en: Affordable basic care with fee disputes

text.en: A number of pet owners praise the hospital for offering accessible rates and saving them money on emergency exams compared to specialty centers. Conversely, multiple visitors complain about unexpected fees, such as unannounced deworming charges and costly paperwork administration. Clients recommend requesting itemized invoices before appointments.

Reviewers frequently raise concerns about communication breakdowns, particularly regarding online appointment inquiries, unreturned voicemail messages, and delayed doctor follow-ups. Clients describe frustration when trying to obtain lab results or international travel paperwork, citing conflicting instructions and prolonged waits without updates.

q.en: Does Killarney Animal Hospital treat small animals and pocket pets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention bringing hamsters, cats, and dogs to the clinic for medical examinations and routine care.

q.en: Can clients book appointments through the clinic website?

a.en: While online booking exists, several reviewers report that online forms and voicemails went unanswered, making direct phone calls more reliable.

q.en: Is Killarney Animal Hospital considered affordable?

a.en: Many pet parents find general exam fees and spay procedures reasonably priced, although some clients report unexpected add-on charges.

q.en: Does the clinic assist with international pet travel documentation?

a.en: The clinic provides health certificates, though reviewers recommend verifying specific country documentation and arrival requirements ahead of time.
